eml_provenance.source: EveMissLab research collection: Adaptive Epistemic Systems (真本體論13)
eml_provenance.extracted_by: Splice (Claude Code), reading the canonical UTF-8 sources and each lab's own result reports
eml_provenance.claim_boundary: status, evidence level and result type follow the source artifact's own stated claim boundary; nothing is upgraded beyond what the report supports

values.eml_summary: Deterministic, executable comparisons that grow round by round: R1 — two facts (one stable, one changing at hours 8 and 16), eight queries over 17 simulated hours, baselines B1 stateless / B2 fixed 6-hour TTL / B3 memory + tools / B4 evented compound agent; R3 — scattered policy vs centralized application gate vs AER-ECT on provenance, stale-write, audit and dependency binding; R4 — policy-topology scaling over N ∈ {1, 4, 16, 64} callers × 6 rules; R5 — ten bypass scenarios across five threat layers; R6 — coherent full-DB forgery, anchor mutation, prefix truncation with/without a trusted head, fail-closed anchor, orphan anchor, adapter conformance.
values.eml_summary_zh: 逐輪成長的決定性可執行比較：R1——兩個事實（一穩定、一在第 8 與 16 小時改變）、17 個模擬小時內 8 次查詢，基線 B1 無狀態／B2 固定 6 小時 TTL／B3 記憶 + 工具／B4 事件驅動複合 agent；R3——分散政策 vs 集中式應用 gate vs AER-ECT，比 provenance、stale write、audit 與依賴綁定；R4——N ∈ {1, 4, 16, 64} 個 caller × 6 條規則的政策拓撲縮放；R5——五個威脅層上的十種繞過情境；R6——連貫的整庫偽造、anchor 竄改、有／無可信 head 的前綴截斷、fail-closed anchor、孤兒 anchor、adapter 一致性。
values.eml_purpose: Ask a narrower question each round: what remains distinct once the baseline is allowed to be as good as AER?
eml_metrics: policy sites, rule placements, blast radius, migration edits
values.eml_evaluation_protocol: Baselines are strengthened deliberately (B4 in R1, centralized gate in R3) so ordinary mechanisms are not attributed to AER; every round states supported and not-measured claims separately.
eml_limitations: Not a general-intelligence benchmark; no performance, cost, security-certification or production claim; the LangGraph round is source-grounded, not executed.
